title: Amorph
description: Six Beatles album covers printed in tens of thousands of dots of ink. Every few seconds, or wherever you click, the print bursts: a fast wave throws every dot out of the picture, swirling and stretching as it flies, the cover changes colour in mid-air, and the dots spring back with a wobble into the next cover. Click again mid-burst and the new one rides on top.
intent: A bold transition that stays physical: every dot rides an underdamped spring that starts softly, flies far, overshoots home and settles, with stretch along its velocity and growth as it lifts toward you; the springs are solved exactly per dot on the GPU, so overlapping bursts add together without a jump.
